featured_reviews.name: ᴇʙɪɴ
featured_reviews.review_text: DiMart is one of the best go-to spot for budget shopping, especially if you're looking for inexpensive clothing. Their selection of groceries and household items is also affordable, though not as cheap as their clothing range. However, be prepared for chaos during holidays—it gets incredibly crowded. The customer service leaves much to be desired; staff often seem clueless about where to find items, which can make shopping frustrating. If you're after deals and can overlook the service and crowds, it's worth a visit for the savings.

featured_reviews.name: tressC
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to shop for all your grocery and toiletries needs because of the great discounts. D Mart caters to all household requirements from A to Z! The staff were helpful & courteous and very hard working, constantly on their feet keeping things by and right. This place gets overcrowded though with entire families coming for all their shopping needs. The best time to enjoy a relaxed shopping experience is 9 to 11 in the mornings and 2 to 5 in the afternoons. It is a store of ground plus two floors so do visit with your walking shoes on 😄

featured_reviews.name: Monika Sharma up
featured_reviews.review_text: I like your service and it’s too good to come there. It’s clean and you have very good service people in their checks you before coming in, and when you go out of the shop, you get ₹20 ice cream in three flavours.

featured_reviews.name: rakesh pareek
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good place for budget shopping of your daily household needs,offer is going on 12 months a year. To save your time you can also order online now from there app "Dmart" to your near by pickup shops that you find in this app.

featured_reviews.name: Nirav Vaghela
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is awesome! 🤩 I always find exactly what I need, and the prices are fantastic. 💰 The staff is super friendly and helpful too. 😊 Such a great shopping experience! 🛒🛍️🌟👍

featured_reviews.name: Nandkishor Thorat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dmart is the place where most of things which are required for daily needs of life are available at reasonable price.

To visit here, try on weekdays or on odd times, or else this is one of the busiest place for shopping. If possible avoid this place on Sunday/holidays/festive time during peak time. As you won’t be able to shop properly.

Second thing to consider with regards to cloths, even if they are cheaper most of the times they won’t last long. So just check the quality or buy the clothes which are bit on Higher sides.

Rest of the products are of good quality.

This Dmart is in between borivali and Dahisar. And is on the Link Road.

Also note: pics uploaded by here are not own by me.

featured_reviews.name: Aadesh Jagdish
featured_reviews.review_text:
This DMart branch in Kandarpada is spacious, well-stocked, and usually very organized. You’ll find everything from groceries, snacks, and dairy to kitchenware, clothes, and daily-use items — all at discounted rates.

Weekends can be crowded, so best to visit on weekdays or early mornings. Billing counters are efficient but expect queues during peak hours. Parking is available but gets full fast.

The store is clean, air-conditioned, and regularly restocked. Staff is helpful if you ask. No public washroom inside, though.

Great spot for budget shopping in Dahisar West.
